name: Galas & Benefits
title: Gala Photography in Cleveland & Miami
description: Gala and benefit photography in Cleveland, Northeast Ohio and Miami. Arrivals, honorees, the program, the auction and the dance floor, photographed for the host, sponsors and press.
lede: The room only looks like this once. We make sure the host, the honorees and every sponsor have the pictures to prove it.
intro: Andrew Stankus Agency photographs galas, benefits and awards nights in Cleveland, across Northeast Ohio and in Miami. We cover the night the way the society pages do: the arrivals and the step-and-repeat, the room before the doors open, the honorees and the speeches, the paddles going up, and the dance floor once the program is done.

For nonprofits, that means images built for the year ahead: sponsor recognition, donor thank-yous, next year's invitation and the annual report. For the press, it means names captioned correctly and the right people in the frame.
cover: Arrivals, red carpet and step-and-repeat portraits. Décor, tablescapes and the room. Honorees, emcees and the program. Live auction, raffles and Raise the Paddle. Sponsors and VIP groups. The after-party.
after: A full online gallery for the host, a select set of highlights first for social and press, and a public recap on our Events page that gives sponsors and guests one more reason to share.
